churches.name: St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church
churches.desc: Large Catholic parish. English Masses: Mon-Fri 6:15 AM, 9:00 AM, 7:00 PM; Sat 8:30 AM, 5:30 PM, 7:00 PM; Sun 7:30 AM, 9:00 AM, 10:30 AM, 5:30 PM, 7:00 PM. Masses in other languages (Malayalam, Tagalog, Tamil, Arabic, Korean, Spanish and more) vary by week: call the parish office, +971 4 884 5251.
